issues.text: The output block was produced by the lab box, whose git is 2.54.0 (git --version in donhang-lab), while content/versions.yaml pins git 2.46. issues.fix: No lesson text change. Either pin git 2.46 in the lab-box image, or have the owner move the versions.yaml git key to 2.54 (then re-run prompt 04 for every lesson with git in versions_used).
